title: HoloMap: Core Loop
summary: Scan terrain, mark decisions, travel the route, then clean up the map.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Scan terrain, mark a route, add hazard or objective notes, travel, then prune or update the map after the run.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each trip, remove stale markers, rename useful ones, and flag the route that actually worked. A crowded map becomes another hazard.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop mapping when the next marker would be guesswork. Travel, verify, and then update the layer with facts.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
